**Background and purpose** **of role:**


BP is driving a central transformation project with an objective to upgrade and standardise the policies, process, control and technology around balance sheet assurance/ reconciliation and journal entry, to implement an integrated solution via Blackline SaaS solution.


The project aims to bring digitization and enhance BP’s balance sheet reconciliation and manual journals operating and assurance capabilities.


This role is going to play a pivotal role as a part of project team. Primary objective of this role is to support be proficient in Blackline maintenance and reporting functionalities. The role requires Blackline admin expertise coupled with finance process and accounting knowledge.


The role entails ample opportunities and requires working with senior collaborators across BP’s GBS teams, liaise with BP\-wide finance and control teams while assisting transformation project team.

Key roles and responsibilities will include:


* Complete the maintenance and configuration of the Blackline platform to ensure optimal performance and alignment with business requirements.
* Configure system settings, user permissions, and access controls according to organizational policies and requirements.
* Handle user assignments within the Blackline platform, including adding new users, updating user profiles, and deactivating accounts as needed.
* Provide user support and fix assistance to address any issues related to user access or functionality within Blackline.
* Maintain precise master data in Blackline, including charts of accounts and mapping tables, ensuring platform\-wide consistency and integrity through regular audits and validation checks.
* Supervise compliance with internal policies, industry regulations, and security standards within the Blackline environment.
* Develop and customize reports in Blackline to supervise key performance indicators (KPIs) related to reconciliation activities and process efficiency.

* Facilitate training sessions for new users to familiarize them with BlackLine functionalities, processes, and guidelines and provide ongoing support and assistance to users, answering inquiries, trousolving issuesd addressing training needs as they arise.

 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner

* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**  

Group Operations within Version 1 is seeking an experienced and results\-driven Operations Coordinator to join our team.


The role plays a critical part in ensuring the smooth and effective running of multiple Practices. As a key member of the Shared Operations Team, you will be responsible for coordinating operational processes, systems, reporting and data governance, providing the insight, structure and support needed to drive operational excellence and business performance. You will also be expected to follow and adhere to established standard operating procedures (SOPs), while identifying opportunities to enhance and improve them where appropriate.


We are looking for an organised, detail\-oriented and solution\-focused individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is motivated by delivering real value. The successful candidate will possess strong commercial awareness, a passion for data and a keen eye for accuracy, while building effective relationships across a wide range of teams and stakeholders. They will have a proven track record of driving outcomes, coordinating activities and getting things done, even where they do not have direct ownership or authority over the resources involved.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Kantata \& Operational Administration**

* Own and coordinate **Kantata**, our centralised timesheet and resourcing tool, including:
* Coordinating ownership of new proposals through CRM synchronisation.
* Managing timesheet administration and follow\-up.
* Working closely with Operations Business Partners (OBPs) to ensure monthly forecasts are in place and accurately maintained.
* Processing end\-of\-tenure leavers.
* Triggering new hire requests (ESRs).
* Maintaining system hygiene and following up on missing business units, unbuilt proposals and other items identified by the Kantata team.
* Ensure key operational data is maintained, reviewed and understood accurately and on a timely basis.

**Financial \& Commercial Data**

* Develop a strong understanding of the financial and commercial drivers within Practice forecasts.
* Monitor and maintain recurring revenue information, ensuring contract data is accurate and revenue is appropriately captured.
* Monitor project resourcing, including available talent and external hiring requirements.
* Monitor individual and team chargeability and understand the key drivers behind week\-on\-week fluctuations.
* Track and report contractor utilisation on a monthly basis.
* Prepare regular reports and provide meaningful insights and key information to support the Leadership Team.

**Governance, Compliance \& Reporting**

* Support compliance reporting across areas including ITIL, Cyber Essentials, phishing awareness and vulnerability communications.
* Support the tracking and governance of operational actions, ensuring appropriate follow\-up and closure.
* Own and/or attend key meetings across the week, ensuring minutes, actions and follow\-ups are accurately documented and progressed.

**Process Improvement \& Automation**

* Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes and procedures within the Practice and across the wider organisation.
* Collaborate regularly with counterparts across the business to promote consistency and a single way of working.
* Identify opportunities to automate operational processes and drive automation where practical and beneficial.
* Proactively identify issues and work with relevant stakeholders to develop and implement solutions.

**General Operations Support**

* Provide general administrative and operational support to the Practice as required.
* Manage multiple priorities effectively, ensuring tasks and activities are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.
* Build strong working relationships with Practice Leads, Delivery Managers and other stakeholders across the business.

 **Qualifications** **Skills, Experience \& Qualifications**

* **At least 5 years' experience** in similar operations, coordination or practice support role.
* Strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in working with data, understanding trends and identifying the drivers behind the numbers.
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
* Good commercial awareness and numerical acumen. A financial background is desirable but not essential.
* Comfortable working with **Excel at an intermediate level**, including lookups and pivot tables.
* Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against deadlines.
* Strong ownership and accountability, with a proven ability to follow tasks through to completion.
* Proactive and solution\-focused, with the confidence to identify issues and initiate appropriate action.
* Collaborative approach, with the ability to bring the right people together to resolve issues and drive outcomes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across different teams and levels of the organisation.
* Discreet and trustworthy, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment and adapting to changing priorities.
* Professional and ethical approach, aligned with Version 1's core values.

 **Additional Information**  

Why Version 1?


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. In your capacity as a BI Manager for Finance, you will drive results by resolving critical inquiries regarding business performance across various financial sectors. You will serve as the lead ambassador for BI programs within the department, steering strategic growth through the creation and oversight of analytical frameworks that shape organizational outcomes.

**In this role, you will:**

* Serve as the main stakeholder liaison for BI architecture, active reports, and incoming reporting requests across Finance.
* Collaborate with Finance partners to analyze business workflows, discover opportunities, and execute core data\-driven programs.
* Convert business needs into structured data models, datasets, and detailed technical specifications.
* Lead the deployment, development, and maintenance of interactive Tableau Cloud dashboards and report portfolios to empower business decision\-making.
* Oversee legacy OBIEE and OAS reporting platforms, maintaining stability while driving strategic migration and modernization efforts.
* Identify architectural bottlenecks and champion continuous improvements across BI systems.
* Align with Data Engineering, Finance, and cross\-functional partners to uphold data governance, accuracy, and consistency.
* Direct the complete lifecycle of reporting solutions from requirement discovery through deployment and support.
* Document report logic, data definitions, and processes to promote self\-service and long\-term knowledge transfer.
* Enforce best practices to guarantee maintainability and technical sustainability over time.

 **Who you are:**

* Professional background with a BE/B.Tech and 8–10 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related fields.
* Proven track record of delivering stakeholder\-facing BI solutions, preferably within Finance or Financial Reporting domains, and co\-ordinate across departments.
* Expertise in dashboard authoring, publishing, and administration using Tableau Cloud (essential).

* Hands\-on experience leveraging Google BigQuery for analytics workflows.
* Skilled in designing BI enterprise architecture and transforming ambiguous business demands into structured technical plans.
* Strong communication and stakeholder leadership skills, equipped to manage competing priorities and act as the BI ambassador for key business units.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and managing a ticketing/workflow tool (e.g., Jira Service Management or something similar ).
* Prior experience in consulting, product\-focused environments, or financial analytics, with financial domain knowledge considered a plus.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.

title: Dir, Software Engrg Mgmt
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

About the team


The CRM \& Industry Workflows (CRM\&I) engineering organisation builds the products that make ServiceNow's CRM vision real: Workplace Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Field Service Management, Sales \& Order Management, and the shared CRM Foundation that underpins them all. Our teams operate from IDC, AMS, and EMEA, and our work spans the full spectrum — from foundational platform capabilities to the agentic experiences that define how enterprises serve their employees and customers.

  

We are in the middle of a fundamental shift. AI is not a layer we are adding on top — it is the new baseline. We are rewriting how products are built, how engineers work, and what 'done' means. If you are energised by that shift and want to lead teams that are living it, read on.


The role


This Director of Software Engineering leads the Workplace engineering pillar within CRM\&I. You will own Workplace Service Delivery and its adjacent integrations with CSM and FSM — building the employee and customer facing experiences that handle millions of service interactions across our largest enterprise customers.

  

What makes this role distinct from a traditional engineering director role is the AI\-native mandate. You will not manage teams that use AI as a productivity tool — you will build and lead an organisation that operates as an AI\-native engineering system. Your engineers work more like architects and verifiers than individual contributors typing every line: they decompose problems into agent\-sized tasks, curate the context that makes agent output reliable, and own the verification harnesses that ensure correctness at scale.

  

You will report to the Senior Director, CRM\&I Engineering and work closely with Workplace product management, platform engineering, and senior stakeholders to shape and deliver the Workplace roadmap for the next three to five years.


What you get to do


Lead and develop an AI\-native engineering organisation

* Build and lead two to three engineering managers who coach their teams to operate with AI\-native practices as the default — not the exception.
* Model and scale the shift from implementation\-speed metrics to judgment metrics: specification quality, architectural soundness, and verification rigour.
* Cultivate a culture where engineers own the correctness of output whether a human or an agent produced it, and are accountable for autonomous decision quality in production.


Drive the Workplace product roadmap

* Partner with product management and UX to define, own, and execute the Workplace Service Delivery roadmap — including employee self\-service, request management, and WSD×CSM/FSM integration.
* Translate ambitious product goals and ambiguous problem statements into precise, testable specifications that both engineers and AI agents can act on with high accuracy.
* Make sound architectural and sequencing decisions early, before agent workstreams begin, and course\-correct quickly when output diverges from intent.


Build reliable AI\-native systems

* Design the verification and guardrail harnesses — automated tests, evaluation suites, CI/CD quality gates, and least\-privilege execution environments — that make agent\-generated output trustworthy at scale.
* Oversee context engineering across your teams: instruction files, architectural decision records, golden examples, and agent\-readable documentation that drive reliable results from AI coding agents.
* Own AI reliability in production: monitor for hallucinations, behavioural drift, and safety regressions; maintain agent observability; and implement rollback mechanisms when autonomous behaviour deviates from intent.


Raise the bar on quality, security, and delivery

* Set and hold the standard for enterprise\-grade software quality — accessible, progressive, and responsive web and mobile experiences at the scale our customers demand.
* Champion security\-minded engineering practices specific to AI\-integrated systems: prompt injection defence, secret and data leakage controls, and tool\-access governance.
* Treat the development process itself as a product: trace failures back to missing specs or context gaps, refine evaluation harnesses, and raise team\-wide throughput and reliability.


Develop the next generation of engineering leaders

* Mentor and grow engineering managers and senior engineers, investing in their technical depth, leadership range, and AI\-native fluency.
* Create a talent environment where engineers who are energised by the AI\-native shift can build careers through some of the most advanced systems in enterprise software.

 **Qualifications**  

To be successful in this role


Experience

* 15\+ years of experience designing and shipping scalable enterprise software products, with significant time in technical leadership roles.
* Demonstrated track record of building and leading engineering teams that have delivered real production systems using AI\-native methods — agentic coding tools, AI\-assisted workflows, and autonomous agent architectures.
* Experience in CRM, ITSM, workplace service delivery, or related enterprise domains preferred.


AI\-native engineering fluency

* Agentic AI and autonomous systems. Hands\-on experience designing and operating autonomous agent systems — planning loops, dynamic tool invocation, memory management, execution policies, and multi\-agent collaboration — that select and sequence actions reliably in production.
* Context engineering. Skill in designing what information models receive, when it is retrieved, and how context evolves. Includes assembling instruction files, documentation, examples, and architectural constraints, as well as architecting retrieval systems, vector databases, and long\-term memory frameworks.
* Verification and harness design. Experience building the guardrail systems that make agent output reliable at scale: property\-based and mutation tests, evaluation suites, CI/CD quality gates, and provenance and permission controls.
* Outcome evaluation. Ability to develop measurable frameworks — benchmarks, golden datasets, continuous evaluation pipelines, and drift detection — that hold production AI to the same rigour as deterministically testable software.
* Security and reliability mindset. Working knowledge of risks specific to AI\-integrated systems: prompt injection, sensitive\-data leakage, tool\-access governance, and model abuse, translated into concrete engineering controls.


Leadership and collaboration

* Strong written and verbal communication — able to operate as a credible technical voice with product, platform, and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and make clear decisions under uncertainty without waiting for perfect information.
* Conviction to influence product vision and roadmap, paired with the humility to listen, learn, and adapt.


Forward deployed engineering

* Customer\-embedded delivery. Experience leading or participating in forward deployed engineering (FDE) engagements — working on\-site or in close collaboration with strategic customers to accelerate time\-to\-value, co\-develop solutions, and unblock adoption of product capabilities.
* Translating customer context into product decisions. Ability to synthesise what you learn at the customer boundary — pain points, integration constraints, workflow gaps, and adoption blockers — into precise product requirements and engineering priorities that feed back into the core roadmap.
* Executive and technical credibility with customers. Comfortable presenting architecture decisions, roadmap trade\-offs, and delivery progress to both customer engineering leads and C\-suite stakeholders, earning trust through technical depth and clear communication rather than sales framing.
* Rapid scoping and delivery under constraints. Skilled at decomposing ambiguous customer problems into tightly scoped engineering workstreams with clear success criteria, then driving rapid iteration cycles — days to weeks, not quarters — while managing risk and communication on both sides.
* Cross\-functional coordination in a customer environment. Experience coordinating across product, sales, and professional services teams while embedded with a customer — navigating competing priorities, escalation paths, and success handoffs without losing engineering focus.


Technical depth

* Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, and modern software development practices.
* Solid data modelling background — relational and otherwise — with experience building systems where data model quality is a first\-class concern.
* Proficiency with AI/ML fundamentals: model training and evaluation, embeddings, and the probabilistic failure modes of LLMs, sufficient to reason about and debug model\-driven behaviour in production.


Even better if you have

* Experience with the ServiceNow platform — scoped application architecture, Glide APIs, or platform engineering at scale.
* Hands\-on exposure to multi\-tenant SaaS architecture and the operational realities of shipping to thousands of enterprise customers simultaneously.
* Experience building and operating agentic systems in a regulated or enterprise\-compliance context.
* Prior experience managing distributed engineering organisations across time zones.
* Direct experience leading forward deployed engineering engagements — co\-developing solutions alongside strategic customers, accelerating adoption of complex capabilities, and feeding field learnings back into the product roadmap.


Why ServiceNow


We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a professional environment built on collaboration and inclusion. This is an organisation where people with strong aptitude and conviction grow fast — working on some of the most advanced enterprise technology in the world, with teams that take the craft seriously.

  

If you want to lead engineering at the frontier of what AI\-native product development actually looks like in production — not in a lab, but at enterprise scale — this is the role.

title: Sr. CSM (Logistics Tech)
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.



Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.



Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.


**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
===================



We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own our enterprise customer relationships end to end. Our CS team owns the full commercial relationship, strategic account management, adoption, renewal, expansion, and customer support, working directly with enterprise customers and their C\-suite. This is a senior individual\-contributor (IC) role for someone who can build trust and credibility at that level.



At the heart of the role is discovery. The best expansion comes from deeply understanding what each customer is really trying to achieve, where their pain sits, and how Portcast turns their data into decisions and measurable business impact. Strong discovery is what lets you deepen adoption, grow your accounts, and drive real revenue from your existing customers, through upsell, cross\-sell, and new teams and regions.



You'll also be technically fluent enough to be the customer's first point of contact on their questions and tickets, triaging the issue, working with our Data team to get the answer, and communicating a clear resolution back to the customer, all alongside the strategic work: QBRs, success plans, renewals, and expansion.

  


### **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**


* Enterprise customers deeply adopt Portcast with measurable business outcomes, and see you as a trusted advisor at both the operational and C\-suite level.
* Discovery that consistently surfaces real customer needs and turns them into adoption, retention, and expansion.
* A steady expansion pipeline from existing accounts (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams and regions), with CS trusted, internally and by customers, to identify and drive those deals.
* Fast, credible resolution of customer questions and tickets, in partnership with the Data team, so customers always get reliable answers and stay confident in Portcast.
### **WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**


* **Own the full enterprise customer lifecycle:** onboarding, adoption, renewal, and retention, ensuring a smooth, high\-impact experience.
* **Lead discovery:** deeply understand each customer's goals, workflows, pain points, and internal decision processes, so you can grow the account and drive expansion.
* **Be a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, including C\-suite,** aligning Portcast to their strategic goals and addressing their challenges.
* **Identify and drive expansion** (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams, new regions) in partnership with Sales, positioning CS as a credible driver of new revenue from existing customers.
* **Own customer questions and tickets:** triage the issue, work with the Data team to get the answer, then review and communicate a clear resolution back to the customer.
* **Run QBRs, success plans, and regular check\-ins,** using data, outcomes, and clear narratives to drive adoption and expansion.
* **Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering** to channel customer feedback and influence the roadmap.
* **Analyze customer usage and data** to surface actionable insights and continuously improve the customer journey.
### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**


* At least 5\+ years in a commercial, customer\-facing role: Customer Success or Key Account Management role within the logistics industry or logistics technology space. An AE/sales or pre\-sales/solutions background is good to have.
* Strong discovery is one of the most important skills in this role, it's what lets you expand existing customers and drive new revenue.
* Logistics / logistics\-tech domain: familiarity with freight forwarding and global logistics workflows, and the ability to confidently engage customers across operations and commercial stakeholders.
* Comfortable with enterprise customers and their C\-suite, with strong stakeholder management across functions and seniority levels.
* Technical fluency: comfortable with basic data, APIs, and SaaS concepts, enough to handle customer questions and tickets, work with our Data team, and translate technical answers into clear customer\-facing resolutions.
* A track record of driving account expansion (upsell, cross\-sell) and revenue growth from existing customers.
* Experience running QBRs and structured account success plans, using data and outcomes to drive adoption and expansion.

Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.

Lead and scale the MES Services business for the Global Delivery Center by building a strong MES competency, driving delivery excellence, and improving margins through standardization and templatization. **Practice \& Business Leadership**

* Partner with regional MES leaders to align offerings, priorities, and execution approach.

* Set the bar for execution excellence across program management, solution delivery, and customer communication.

* Establish and enforce project governance across MES programs (scope, schedule, risk, quality, and stakeholder management).
* Ensure consistent delivery standards, templates, and quality gates across all projects.
* Provide leadership for escalations, enable corrective actions, and institutionalize lessons learned.

**Standardization, Templatization \& Margin Improvement**

* Build and maintain reusable assets (delivery playbooks, templates, accelerators, estimation models, reference architectures).
* Drive productivity and margin improvements by increasing reuse and reducing delivery variability.
* Track and improve practice KPIs (margin, utilization, schedule predictability, quality, CSAT).

* Develop MES techno\-functional capability across architecture, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and hyper care.
* Define skill matrices, learning paths, certifications, mentoring plans, and succession pipeline.
* Establish communities of practice and continuous improvement mechanisms across delivery teams.

**People Leadership (People First)**

* Lead, coach, and mentor practice leaders, project managers, architects, and delivery teams.
* Build a high\-performing culture with strong engagement, accountability, and career growth.
* Drive performance management, talent development, and retention initiatives.

**Customer Engagement \& Pipeline Growth**

* Demonstrated success in improving margins via standardization, templatization, and governance.
* Strong executive stakeholder management, communication, and customer\-facing leadership.
* Track record of building and scaling competencies, teams, and delivery leaders.

* Excellent people management and coaching capability; strong “people\-first” mindset.
* Practice leadership: operating model, governance, metrics, delivery excellence.
* Business acumen: profitability/margins, utilization, productivity, pipeline contribution.
* Collaboration: strong partnership with regional counterpart and cross\-functional teams.

AVEVA platform experience preferred, with demonstrated exposure to delivering MES solutions leveraging AVEVA technologies (e.g., AVEVA MES / related AVEVA digital manufacturing ecosystem).

* A scalable MES delivery model with strong governance and predictable outcomes.
* Measurable margin improvement through reuse and delivery standardization.
* Strong MES competency/bench with clear career paths and reduced key\-person dependency.
* Increased pipeline and expanded customer footprint through proactive engagement.
